title: The boundary keys were judged against the wrong adapter and declared inert

incident.mechanism: @paperclipai/adapter-pi-local serves `pi`; these agents run on @zhafron/paperclip-omp-adapter. Reading the wrong package produced the claim that the first-class keys are ignored and only extraArgs reaches the CLI. A gate built on that belief FAILED a correct config and would have PASSED a config that armed nothing — tools, policy overlay, extension, worktree hook — while looking configured.

trigger: an adapterConfig using the first-class keys the OMP adapter really reads
assertion: each key reaches argv as its own flag, in the adapter's order, with extraArgs appended last
